faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 23 October 2026.

faq.answer: There is no application to send in advance. Attend the walk-in interview on 23 October 2026 with your documents.
